Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1221
Claimant:
Cynthia Gordon
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
5-25-24
Claim opened after the insured reported a rear-end collision. The claimant is represented by counsel, so all contact
will go through the attorney's office. The driver is named on the policy and coverage is being confirmed.
6-19-24
The claimant's attorney sent the initial injury notice describing whiplash. The file has no medical records yet, and it is
not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
6-28-24
Police confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. Nothing independent confirms the accident itself: there
are no witnesses to the impact, no photos and no other report.
8-28-24
The claimant's account has changed between conversations. The direction of the impact and the number of people in
the car are now described differently than in the first call.
9-23-24
Inspection shows vehicle damage that matches the impact described. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known to
us. A neighbor has mentioned seeing the car damaged some weeks before the claimed loss, and I am following up
on that.
10-20-24
The medical records show a small strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fully. Treatment after this
calim followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
12-22-24
File is being prepared for review with the injury question still open. Next steps are to request complete prior records
and to schedule a recorded statement with the claimant through counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
